title: Poor Keyboard Support
body:
While I understand building Google Sheets with the touch interface of iOS in mind, there are users who plan to do more complicated work with Sheets with a keyboard, especially with the emergence of the iPad Pro line with the smart keyboard.

I was expecting an experience closer to desktop, but even with a keyboard Sheets can't do anything too complicated without it being too difficult. 

Simple keyboard commands don't work as they should like cmd+X,C or V. You have to manually tap the screen to do any copy and pasting. 

Highlighting cells don't work well on a keyboard either, you cannot hold Shift + Ctr to highlight a bunch of cells to the end, you need to manually hold with your finger and drag it. Imagine doing that with thousands of rows. 

Overall, I was hoping with a keyboard and iOS, productivity can be had with Google Sheets. Sorely disappointed. :(
